title: Senior technicians are the only knowledge base
source_story: User-provided fictional owner stories in this conversation; opening narrative below is a faithful condensed adaptation, not a verbatim transcript.
business_context: 13 staff; two long-serving technicians carry most customer-specific knowledge.
owner_narrative: Juniors call seniors while both are on jobs. Manuals and old notes are scattered across folders and chat. A recurring school printer configuration is repeatedly rediscovered. End-of-day notes just say fixed, and seniors worry about procedures being applied without their exceptions.

diagnoses.hypothesis: Resolution context is not captured, scoped, reviewed or retired, so experience cannot transfer reliably.
diagnoses.counterhypothesis: If the problem requires specialist judgement or physical experience, documents may reduce interruptions but cannot replace training.

interventions.process_first: Capture symptoms, environment, tests, result and exceptions; assign review owners and retirement dates.
interventions.deterministic_and_assisted_automation: Draft knowledge articles from redacted job notes; retrieve by environment and scope; show sources and review status to technicians.
interventions.rejected_default: Do not replace the whole service platform or deploy autonomous agents solely because the owner reports inefficiency.
interventions.selection_basis: Choose the least complex intervention addressing the supported handoff failure; compare added administration and integration burden.

acceptance_tests.scenario_and_expected_result: A version-mismatched procedure carries a warning.
A junior cannot retrieve another customer’s restricted configuration.
A superseded article links to its replacement.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Reviewed technical knowledge management and retrieval need a dedicated extension.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.

evaluation.primary_metric_definition: Repeat investigations requiring senior escalation / eligible repeat incidents; also monitor incorrect procedure application.
measurement_cautions: Use a stable denominator and comparable operating periods.
Record missingness and changed case mix.
Do not infer staff reductions from reclaimed task minutes.

implementation.baseline: Collect at least one representative operating cycle before rollout; for monthly billing or maintenance include the relevant full cycle. Extend sampling when volumes or seasonality make the sample unrepresentative.
implementation.scope: Start with one consenting customer group and the staff who own its handoffs; include a normal case and each listed exception.
sequence: Reconcile identities and existing obligations with the process owner.
Run the proposed rules in shadow mode; record disagreements and missed exceptions.
Approve a bounded live pilot only after requirements and exceptions have named owners.
Review outcome metrics, added administrative work and failure logs before expanding.
implementation.simulated_resolution: In this fictional case, MILO introduced the process change: Capture symptoms, environment, tests, result and exceptions; assign review owners and retirement dates. The team adopted the proposed workflow for the pilot scope. Routine coordination became explicit; unresolved exceptions continued to require a person.
implementation.simulated_lesson: If the problem requires specialist judgement or physical experience, documents may reduce interruptions but cannot replace training.
implementation.rollback: Pause automated writes and notifications, retain the event log, export outstanding work and return to a named manual coordinator. Reconcile queued events before resuming to avoid duplicate actions.
implementation.go_no_go: Process owner reviews coverage of acceptance cases, unresolved critical failures, metric direction and staff workload. No fixed performance threshold is claimed without customer agreement.

open_questions: Actual solution accuracy requires expert review; synthetic procedures must never become device repair authority.
